conclusion: Feasible for a controlled training integration. Synthetic position/density/color fitting through the actual upstream CUDA renderer passed. Full scene training, densification/pruning/resume, clipping semantics and large-scene memory/performance remain unvalidated.

probe.scope: Synthetic SH0 teacher fitting with unmodified upstream RadFoam CUDA forward/backward and Python TraceRays autograd; C ABI headless bridge; default stream; 64 trainable sites plus 8 fixed zero-density guard sites; 1536 rays; graph rebuilt every step. Not a full dataset run or upstream train.py/densification/resume test.
probe.allocator: Headless bridge uses cudaMalloc/cudaFree and explicit synchronization instead of the upstream Torch allocator. No training-performance or memory-performance claim.

integration_surface.work: Introduce a backend factory at both initialization paths and rebuild. Warpower initializes once with warp.init(), receives detached float32 CUDA sites under no_grad(), and returns stable-ID CSR adjacency. Keep native RadFoam and Paragram options for paired comparisons.

Retain TraceRays and existing position/appearance/density gradients. Adjacency is discrete and has no gradient. Keep each graph alive until its forward/backward finishes; rebuild after optimizer.step.

Use checked int32-to-uint32 tensor views for nonnegative compact indices and offsets; no data copy is needed. Retain tensor owners. Current Warpower signed-int32 capacity is the practical index limit.

An identity-permutation adapter avoids external index changes initially. If spatially sorting for AABB/renderer locality, permute positions, attributes, density and Adam moments together. Rebuild/invalidate adjacency and cached index hints after any pruning/densification.

Retain RadFoam AABB construction, nearest starting-cell queries, farthest-neighbor query, image batching, renderer and checkpoint paths. Identity point order is correct for AABB bounds but its performance needs measurement because leaves group contiguous points.

Start with the original cadence: interval grows from 1 by 2 until roughly 100, resets after densification, and forces rebuilds after densification and at the point-freeze boundary. Native incremental updates are not equivalent to full reconstruction. Warpower can initially fully rebuild at each requested update.

Run initial integration on the CUDA default stream. Warpower honors the Torch current stream, while upstream renderer launches with a null stream; custom-stream production needs explicit event ordering or stream plumbing.
Use voronoi_diagram, not power_diagram with optical density as weights. Density is a rendering attribute. Weighted cells would require renderer plane and gradient changes.

validation_gates: Turn the seven confirmed Warpower neighbor-pair errors in the prior full-checkpoint comparison into targeted render/gradient regression cases; zero status codes alone do not certify topology.

Resolve clipping semantics: Warpower adjacency is bounded by the site-derived box, while upstream tracing has no explicit box stop. Validate all camera and contributing ray domains, or add compatible domain handling. The inward-ray guard-site probe does not settle this for real scenes.

Run identical frozen scene/camera batches with native/Paragram/Warpower graphs. Compare RGBA, opacity, depth and raw gradients before upstream nonfinite masking, including rays through known problematic facets.

Run a small Bonsai image-fitting pilot that includes actual densification, pruning, frozen-point transition, checkpoint save/load and continued optimization. Start all backends from the same scene/optimizer snapshot and controlled ray batches.

Run matched full Bonsai then Garden fits; record quality versus wall time, native incremental/full updates separately, AABB/start queries, rendering/backward/optimizer, host synchronization, retry/failure counts and combined Torch/Warp memory.
performance_limits: The prior static L40 construction comparison measured 1.30-1.87x over Paragram. It is not a predicted whole-training speedup, and native RadFoam incremental timings were not measured there.

Do not carry the standalone 32 GiB Warp allocator retention policy into training without budgeting for Torch parameters, gradients, Adam state and rendering buffers. Profile chunk sizes and combined allocator reservations.
The standalone 2-4.2M-site peaks were about 7.9-14.7 GiB for Warpower. A 48 GiB L40 makes a 2-4M-site pilot plausible but the full training peak is unmeasured; 20M-site scaling is not established.
available_assets: Local data/radfoam NPZ files contain final site positions only. Real fitting needs RGB images, calibrated cameras and COLMAP sparse points (or another supported initialization), and checkpoint colors/densities if starting from a trained checkpoint.
scope_exclusions: No changes to Warpower library code or the upstream RadFoam checkout.
No full dataset training, native RadFoam triangulation benchmark, densification/pruning/resume run, or production stream/memory validation.
The first probe run is preserved separately; its graph-change count used raw CSR ordering. Use probe.json for canonical edge-set counts.
